propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same identity in both live and retired state, detectable but only safely repairable at the write-bearing reconcile boundary, not during construction or preview.

Incomplete-operation recovery must be invoked after the under-lock staleness gate but before the first remote issue fetch, and must validate exact identity agreement between tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry before removing the redundant pair.
Explicit unretire removes the tombstone intent; later automatic confirmations (200 response, clear_absent, same-key bind_confirm) do not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity.
The rich-text handler must be cut to use the narrow S2 facade operation instead of mutating entries obtained from all_bindings() in production code.
